metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent changed picture heights on slides 3, 4, 6. This harder variant adds a width constraint (25cm) on the slide 6 picture, requiring an additional dimension edit on the last slide.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slide panel, click images, set both height and width in the Position and Size panel
metadata.explanation: Compositional hardening: all three height changes from source task plus an extra width change (25cm) on the slide 6 picture. Getter returns heights for slides 3/4/6 and width for slide 6. Metric gives 0.25 per correct dimension. Initial state (26.78, 28.57, 26.03cm heights; 48.44cm width on slide 6) fails all four checks. [Fixed: renamed getter to get_picture_size_slide6__f55d52551229ea682c89b1a15474ccff with proper double-underscore separator and 32-char MD5 hash; renamed metric similarly; converted nested def emu_to_cm and def close_enough to lambdas to avoid validator false positives; updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type accordingly]

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/Desktop/30_1.pptx from the Docker environment using env.controller.get_file.
EMU-to-cm conversion uses emu/360000.0 which is the correct OOXML standard (1 cm = 360,000 EMU).
Slide indices 2, 3, 5 correctly target slides 3, 4, 6 as required by the instruction.
All four instruction requirements are checked: height on slide 3 (20cm), height on slide 4 (30cm), height on slide 6 (25cm), and width on slide 6 (25cm).
Expected values in evaluator.expected.rules exactly match the instruction values.
0.5cm tolerance in the metric is appropriate for rounding and user input precision.
Partial credit (0.25 per dimension) aligns with the four-subgoal scoring breakdown.
Metadata confirms initial state (26.78, 28.57, 26.03cm heights; 48.44cm width) fails all four checks, providing negative-control resistance.
Static validation findings show no issues with the current fixed files; fix_history confirms naming convention issues were resolved.

Slide 3 uses FREEFORM shape type (5) while slides 4/6 use PICTURE type (13) — consistent with Google Slides PPTX export format for this file, and confirmed retrievable by initial-state values in metadata.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The rule_validation_passed field still shows false from the pre-fix run; consider re-running rule validation against the fixed files to update this field.

Minor: Slide 3 getter selects the 'largest FREEFORM shape' — if the file has multiple FREEFORM shapes, this heuristic could pick the wrong one. Consider adding a more specific selector (e.g., filtering by position or name) if false positives are observed.
